verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-mode/stream architecture (full refresh vs incremental, per-connection schema/version control) implies per-table reset/backfill without touching the whole pipeline, and the Connection Timeline lets engineers monitor individual stream sync history. However, no doc explicitly documents a 'resync single stream' button/workflow, and a hands-on report describes having to 'trick' Airbyte into recognizing a large table's first sync rather than a clean built-in resync path, showing real friction at scale. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the stream-level reset/backfill UI action, and confirmation it works smoothly for very large tables without workarounds.
